story.title: Shaan's incredible insects
paragraphs_en: Shaan is curious about incredible insects. He went to the garden to find few incredible insects. He took the magnifying glass along with him. Let's join Shaan to find few incredible insects.
Look, Shaan spots a lady bug, an insect that is red with black spots. The lady bugs are very helpful insects, they eat bugs called aphids that harm plants.
Look, Shaan spots beautiful butterflies, these insects have colourful wings.
Look, Shaan spots a dragonfly, this insect is an expert flier, it hovers like a helicopter.
Look, Shaan spots honey bees, they live in hives. They are always busy making honey. Yummy!
Look, Shaan spots a grasshopper, this insect eats plants and grass. A grasshopper can not only fly, it can also jump.
Look, Shaan spots leaf insects, these insects look like leaves they are also called walking leaves.
Look, Shaan spots a group of ants, they are social insects. A group of ants is called an army.
After looking at all the bugs, Shaan was curious to count the black spots on the lady bug. He went back to the lady bug and started counting the black spots.
